_doc: The Remand (ADR-0058): convicts the Program dropped into the valley, the player among them, and those who throw in with them: Ezra Vane, the companion. A faction only so bodies know whose side they are on (relations, symmetric, FactionDef.hostile): the Hollowed and the Ashen fight a Remand body on sight, and it fights them. No camps, levels, raids or morale: nothing escalates.

defs.name: The Remand
defs.description: Convicts dropped into the valley by the Remand Program, and anyone who throws in with them.
